title: Killa Cola Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Cola Nicotine Pouches deliver the classic taste of cola, enhanced with an extra-strong nicotine experience. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it a suitable choice for adult users who enjoy a steady and satisfying nicotine release. The Cola flavour provides a familiar, refreshing taste, offering a unique twist to your nicotine routine. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Cola pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with an emphasis on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Cola offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a classic flavour while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
